title: Notes
body:
It’s one feature I like the most . But there are certain problems with the app.
1. Typing and keypad have certain defects. The cursor is not precise and stable. Sometimes it does not move with the tap. It gets stuck on a word. That requires effort to drag it to a desired point.
2. Selection function is also cumbersome. A slightly heavy file, say more than thirty pages cannot be selected. Select all function does not work. 
3. It’s not possible to email a folder. Only individual files can be emailed. That takes a lot of time. 
4. File with images cannot be indented.
